clauses.clause: You may activate loyalty abilities of Teferi on any player's turn any time you could cast an instant.
clauses.evidence: Tree StaticAbility GRANT_ACTIVATION IS_SOURCE window INSTANT (compiler's parse), only Teferi's own abilities. Pack P1cb15ad032_teferi_once_per_turn.json PASSES: the grant does not lift the once-per-turn loyalty limit (a second +1 in the same turn is refused).
clauses.issue: engine-limit: no priority; the non-active player has no action window, so Teferi's loyalty abilities are used only in his controller's own action window (sorcery-like). Weaker than printed, never stronger.

clauses.clause: [+1]: Draw a card, then discard a card.
clauses.evidence: [activate [1]] variants: LOYALTY 3 -> 4, you draw Library 5#1, then 'ask one_of' over the whole hand including the drawn card; the chosen card goes to the graveyard (every option honoured).

clauses.clause: [-3]: Target creature you don't control phases out. (Treat it and anything attached to it as though they don't exist until its controller's next turn.)
clauses.evidence: 'ability [2] target slot: 1..1 of [opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant]' (opponent's creatures only); each variant: LOYALTY 3 -> 0 (Teferi to the graveyard) and the target 'battlefield -> battlefield (phased out)'. Pack P1cb15ad032_teferi_phase_out_my_turn.json PASSES (it cannot block and is still phased out at the end of my turn); pack P1cb15ad032_teferi_phase_in_next_turn.json PASSES (phased in on the opponent's next turn).

clauses.clause: [-10]: Take two extra turns after this one.
clauses.evidence: 'ability [3] not activatable: cost:loyalty:3<10'. Tree EXTRA_TURN count 2 (compiler's parse). Pack P1cb15ad032_teferi_two_extra_turns.json PASSES: turn_seats [0, 0, 0, 1].
